name: Friendship
description:
Each of your captured creatures has a Friendship score ranging from 0–10.

A creature’s starting Friendship is set by your Capture ability and can be increased using your Train ability. A creature loses 1 Friendship whenever it is knocked unconscious, whenever you or an ally deal damage to it, or whenever it spends a full day out of its vessel without seeing you. A creature's Friendship score determines its behavior:

  • Friendship 0: The creature seeks to escape your control. If it is allowed out of its vessel, it immediately attempts to flee and may attack anyone who blocks its escape.

  • Friendship 1–4: The creature is indifferent to positively inclined toward you, but may wander or flee if left outside its vessel for more than a few minutes.

  • Friendship 5+: You may keep the creature outside its vessel without risk of losing it. It willingly accompanies you and obeys your commands. You may still have only one captured creature summoned at a time.

  • Friendship 6+: The creature is loyal. Whenever it would use its BODY, HEART, or WITS score, it may instead use its Friendship score.

  • Friendship 10: The creature shares a deep bond of trust with you. You may issue complex, multi-step, time-sensitive commands that are reasonable given its level of intelligence, and it will travel any distance to carry them out. Additionally, its Friendship cannot be reduced below 5 due to being separate from you if it begins the separation with a Friendship score of 10.

Describe how your friendship evolves.
